metadata.description: Antigravity CLI integration for Claude Code — use Google's `agy` from inside your editor. Forked from simplybychris/antigravity-plugin-cc.

plugins.name: agy-bridge
plugins.description: Use Google's Antigravity CLI (`agy`) from Claude Code: offload bulk reads read-only and get a short cited answer back, delegate tasks, review the current diff, ask for a second opinion, and optionally run the work on the Claude models agy offers, on your Google plan instead of your Claude subscription. Commands are /agy-bridge:*. Named `agy` before 0.10.0. Forked from simplybychris/antigravity-plugin-cc.
